faqs.question: Are your puppies vaccinated and health-checked?
faqs.answer: Every TeddyPup undergoes thorough veterinary examinations before joining our family. They come with all age-appropriate vaccinations (DHPPi), microchipped, fully dewormed, and accompanied by an official veterinary health passport and medical record.

faqs.question: Can I meet a puppy before I decide?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! We welcome you to visit our luxury showroom in Downtown Dubai (by appointment) to spend quality time playing and bonding with our available local puppies. For imported puppies currently in Korea, our concierge will arrange real-time live WhatsApp HD video calls so you can see them interactive and playing.

faqs.question: Can I take my puppy home the same day?
faqs.answer: For puppies already residing in our Downtown Dubai showroom who have fulfilled their clinical checks, same-day collection or white-glove chauffeur delivery to your residence across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the Northern Emirates is readily available.

faqs.question: Do you import puppies from abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in exclusive Korean teacup and teddy-bear breeds (Maltipoo, Poodle, Pomeranian) from prestigious ethical breeding partners in South Korea known for exceptional doll faces, compact teacup proportions, and calm, loving temperaments.

faqs.question: How does an imported puppy travel to Dubai safely?
faqs.answer: Imported puppies fly under direct temperature-controlled, pet-safe pressurized cabin standards with accredited pet travel couriers. They arrive safely at Dubai International Airport (DXB), clear ministry veterinary clearance smoothly, and rest comfortably before arriving in your arms.

faqs.question: Will I see photos and health details first on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our entire concierge process is conducted via WhatsApp. We will share high-resolution videos, close-up photos, parent breed lineage, weight progression charts, and veterinary notes before you confirm your reservation.

faqs.question: Do you deliver across the UAE and worldwide?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer white-glove doorstep delivery across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, RAK, and Fujairah. We also coordinate international concierge shipping to clients across the GCC (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and worldwide with complete export documentation.

faqs.question: Which breeds do you usually have?
faqs.answer: We specialize in small and teacup companion breeds: Maltipoo, Korean Teacup Poodle, Miniature Pomeranian, Cavapoo, and Shih Tzu. We focus exclusively on hypoallergenic, apartment-friendly, gentle companion dogs.

faqs.question: Is there help after my puppy comes home?
faqs.answer: Our relationship begins the day your puppy comes home! You receive 24/7 WhatsApp concierge support for nutrition questions, potty training guidance, vaccination scheduling, and lifetime care advice.
